headline: Your HitHorizons waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing B2B SaaS, CRM/ERP operators, and outbound teams selling into Europe into the right HitHorizons company-data API, Screener, or enrichment offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Paulina Banska, Head of Sales.
productSummary: HitHorizons (hithorizons.com) is a European company-data SaaS powered by FinStat, s.r.o. (Bratislava). It provides a database of 80M+ / 80+ million companies across 50 European countries with 100+ data points per company, delivered via HitHorizons Screener (filter + CSV export up to 50,000 records) and HitHorizons API: Sales & Marketing Data API (CRM autofill from company name, national ID, or VAT; sales, employees, industry/SIC, LinkedIn/Facebook links), Screener API (lead import by country/region/industry/SIC/employees/sales filters), and Invoicing Data API (local legal name, address, VAT for ERP billing — selected countries). Public use cases name CRM enrichment (Pipedrive, Salesforce, MS Dynamics, HubSpot), ERP (Oracle, SAP), B2B ecommerce, and BI dashboards — without integrating dozens of local country APIs. Microsoft Dynamics 365 marketplace extension (finstatsro.hithorizons_dynamics_extend) adds autofill + Screener inside Dynamics. FinStat has served over 4,000 customers since 2013 (Dynamics marketplace copy). Paulina Banska is Head of Sales (paulina.banska@hithorizons.com).
coreInsight: Paulina sells one European company-data platform — Screener + Sales & Marketing Data API + Invoicing Data API — not a different product per vertical. Vertical and country (DACH, Nordics, Visegrad, UK & Ireland, Southern Europe, etc.) are merge tags after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is eu_company_data_stack: which European firmographic / enrichment stack a lead source can already see (named competitor EU company-data tool; CRM with European TAM and no HitHorizons; outbound / lead-gen tooling aimed at Europe; or none). That ladder maps to HitHorizons live offers: competitor switch, CRM Enrichment API brief (Dynamics-native where detected), Screener lead-list brief, then a soft remaining-TAM European Company Data Playbook.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is which European company-data stack they already run
sections.takeaway: BuiltWith, G2, job ads, CRM detections, and outbound-tool mentions already show Creditsafe / BvD Orbis / D&B / Kompass, a Dynamics-Salesforce-HubSpot CRM aimed at Europe, or Apollo/Clay/Instantly EU outbound — or none. That eu_company_data_stack is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM CRM, SaaS, and outbound account selling into Europe
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Named EU company-data competitors first, then CRM with European TAM and no HitHorizons, then outbound / lead-gen into Europe, then every remaining in-TAM account.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each eu_company_data_stack band gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Competitor tools get an EU Data Switch Brief. CRM-with-EU-gap accounts get a CRM Enrichment API Brief. Outbound-into-Europe accounts get a Screener Lead-List Brief. The rest get the European Company Data Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Switch the EU data vendor, enrich the CRM, fill the Screener list, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always B2B teams that sell into or operate across Europe — the buyers HitHorizons already names (CRM, ERP, sales, BI). Country cluster and CRM brand are merge tags. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (price/coverage vs API simplicity).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the European company-data stack already visible
sections.takeaway: Notice the competitor, the CRM gap, or the EU outbound signal, poke the local-API / incomplete-firmographic friction that stack implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the competitor-switch route first
sections.takeaway: Start where eu_company_data_stack already shows Creditsafe, BvD/Orbis, D&B, Kompass, or a peer. Prove reply density, then roll CRM Enrichment API, Screener Lead-List, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav (B2B SaaS / agencies / mid-market selling into Europe; titles: Head of Sales, RevOps, Sales Ops, CRM Admin, Head of Data, Finance Ops) are the TAM HitHorizons already sells into via CRM enrichment, Screener lead gen, and Invoicing Data API. Exact public buyer-TAM account count is not published on hithorizons.com (80M+ is the companies IN the database, not buyer TAM); treat buyer TAM size as estimated and keep each launch tier >=~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same BuiltWith + G2/review + careers + job-ad + CRM detection pull returns eu_company_data_stack: competitor_eu_data (Creditsafe, Bureau van Dijk / Orbis / Moody's, Dun & Bradstreet, Kompass, Europages, North Data, adjacent EU firmographic vendors); crm_eu_gap (Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive on stack + EU HQ or EU-selling ICP, no named competitor and no HitHorizons); outbound_eu (Apollo / Clay / Instantly / Sales Nav heavy EU targeting or open SDR/BDR hiring for Europe, no Tier 1–2); or none — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live HitHorizons positioning on hithorizons.com: one API instead of dozens of local country APIs; Sales & Marketing Data API autofill into CRM; Screener filter + CSV export up to 50,000 records; Invoicing Data API for ERP VAT/legal address; Dynamics 365 marketplace extension; site proof 80M+ companies / 50 countries / 100+ data points; FinStat 4,000+ customers since 2013 (Dynamics marketplace).

Country cluster (DACH, Nordics, Visegrad, UK & Ireland, Southern Europe, Benelux & France, Baltics, Balkans) and CRM brand are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

routingRules.why: Already a HitHorizons / FinStat customer. Suppress when Paulina's team can share a list; public case quotes alone are not a franchise-wide exclude.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eu_company_data_stack = competitor_eu_data (Creditsafe, Bureau van Dijk / Orbis / Moody's, Dun & Bradstreet, Kompass, Europages, North Data, or adjacent named EU firmographic / company-data vendor) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They already pay for European company data. Strongest switch intent for HitHorizons one-API coverage of 80M+ companies / 50 countries / 100+ data points instead of stitching local registers or a legacy bureau stack.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eu_company_data_stack = crm_eu_gap (Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive detected + EU HQ or EU-selling ICP; no Tier-1 competitor; no HitHorizons) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: CRM is live and Europe is in the ICP, but firmographics are incomplete. Maps to Sales & Marketing Data API autofill (name / national ID / VAT → address, industry, SIC, sales, employees, social links) and the Dynamics 365 marketplace extension when crm_stack = Dynamics.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eu_company_data_stack = outbound_eu (Apollo / Clay / Instantly / Sales Nav heavy EU targeting OR open SDR/BDR / Sales Ops EU hiring; no Tier 1–2) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are actively building European outbound lists. Maps to HitHorizons Screener: 18 filters, sort by sales/employees, CSV export up to 50,000 records, plus Screener API import into their tools.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (B2B teams selling into or operating across Europe). Softest CTA around one European company-data layer for CRM, lead gen, and invoicing. Mandatory 100% coverage.

launchPlan: Suppress visible HitHorizons / FinStat customers first when Paulina's team can share a customer list.
Launch Tier 1 EU Data Switch Brief; hold until >=~1,500 contacts when TAM allows, else run smaller waves with longer reply-density read.
Roll Tier 2 CRM Enrichment API Brief (A/B Dynamics-native vs Salesforce/HubSpot/Pipedrive API), then Tier 3 Screener Lead-List Brief.
Open Catch-all European Company Data Playbook for remaining TAM.
A/B inside exclusive routes: coverage / price vs API simplicity (one API vs dozens of local APIs); Tier 1 can chaos-test switch-speed vs enrichment-depth framing.
Keep country cluster (DACH vs Nordics vs Visegrad vs UK & Ireland, etc.) and CRM brand as merge tags only — do not split into parallel waterfalls per region.
